note: The bands the Zagi plant has to land in, from docs/ZAGI-STAGE1.md, which derives each from Zagi's published figures for its 48 in Zagi HP, the planform Trick R/C drew for the Zagi-400 X and a vortex lattice on it (scripts/zagi-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

z1_level_75.source: level speed at three quarter throttle, the thrust against the drag; the band 12 percent either side, the Kadet's and the P-51's; re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 5 x 5E curve for the carbon 5 x 5 (prop curves, scripts/zagi-derive.js), was 22.14 on the straight line (19.48 to 24.8)

z2_stall.source: the trimmed stall: the wing's CL max 0.928 less the lift of the 3.5 deg of up elevon that holds it there, 0.821; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.9283 / 4.1152; the band the P-51's in proportion

z3_glide.source: best L/D, power off, at its speed, 9.41 m/s, where the elevons neutral trim it; the band the P-51's in proportion

z4_top.source: level speed at full throttle; the band the P-51's in proportion, 9.0 percent under and 12.0 over; re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 5 x 5E curve for the carbon 5 x 5 (prop curves, scripts/zagi-derive.js), was 29.69 on the straight line (27.01 to 33.26). Zagi's 'Top Speed 85 MPH', 38 m/s, was past what the straight line gave the published motor and prop, docs/ZAGI-STAGE1.md; on the curve it is 3 percent over the derived figure and inside the band

z5_climb.source: best climb at full throttle, at 22.2 m/s; the band 25 percent either side, the P-51's; re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 5 x 5E curve for the carbon 5 x 5 (prop curves, scripts/zagi-derive.js), was 8.88 at 16.2 m/s on the straight line (6.66 to 11.1), and the sweep moved with the best climb's speed, 2 m/s steps about it as before (was 12 to 20)

z6_roll.source: full elevon from level at 15 m/s: the helix angle a full roll's time gives, 2 pi over the time less the roll's own lag, derived 0.2236 (315 deg/s, a roll in 1.19 s); 25 percent either side, the P-51's

z7_pitch.source: pitch sensitivity, a tailless wing's: from the hands off glide, power off, a tenth of up stick. The nose answers at once, the pitch rate's first peak 0.098 s after the step on the linear short period (the Zagi's pitch inertia is small and its pitch damping a third or less of the tailed aircraft's here), the band 35 percent under and 50 over, the Edge's; and the glide it settles to has its angle of attack moved 1.67 deg per deg of elevon, -cm_de / cm_alpha, a small margin's large gain, 15 percent either side

z8_no_rudder.source: no rudder: a flight with full yaw stick held is bit identical to the same flight without it

z9_stall.source: the straight stall, power off, full up held from 1.4 Vs: 'if it balloons up and then dives for the ground (stalls)' and 'a mush condition (partial stall) with a loss of roll control' (CRRC, Zagi THL Tips): the wings stay within 5 deg of level, the nose rises and then falls below the horizon within 3 s, and it settles into a mush past the stall angle, sinking 0.61 to 4.25 m/s, pitch never past 45 deg. The sink band re-derived 2026-10-11 (was 2 to 6, from no source): scripts/zagi-derive.js brackets the mush between the wing still attached at its CL max (0.61) and a fully separated plate at 30 deg on Ostowari and Naik's measured broadside coefficient at AR 6, 1.32 (SERI/STR-217-2559 sec. 4.6) (4.25); the balloon and the break within 3 s are the CRRC's

z10_turn_stall.source: 'A stall in a turn will result in a spin. Spins happen because of too much control or too little speed' (Zagi HP manual): from a 30 deg bank at 1.4 Vs, the throttle closed and the elevons pulled to full up over 3 s, full roll into the turn held rolls it once round within 4 s, where the same pull with the bank held on the roll stick keeps it within 20 deg of its bank

z11_throw.source: the manual's launch: a good strong throw, level, motor off, then full throttle 'when the Zagi is a comfortable distance from the ground': it never touches the ground and is above 5 m after 5 s

z12_belly.source: 'a slow sink rate to a sliding landing': a power off glide from 8 m, flared, touches down on the belly and slides to rest upright, the CG on the hull's 12 mm, the drawn root's underside on the ground

z13_thermal.source: 'Motor up to those distant thermals then power-down and soar with the hawks' (Zagi, of the Zagi-400): circling the first thermal's core power off, a 30 deg bank at 9.5 m/s, 16 m out (V^2 / (g tan 30)), where the core rises 1.9 m/s against the circle's sink of 0.87: it gains height over 40 s, at least 0.3 m/s averaged over the whole of them, where the same circle in still air loses it. The maps have no ridge lift

z17_unmoved.source: every other aircraft's recorded flight hash, on main's module before the Zagi (main b82865f, the Ugly Stik in): the Zagi's table, the elevons on the strips and a surface on a stalled wing move none of them; the Edge and the Extra left the list when they were removed on 2026-09-29 Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was. Re-pinned 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): the P-51's two recorded flights (p51 was 7219c30ebb48a05c, p51-air 4646a1ba51f005db) moved with its stall taken from measured sections, stall_re and stall_round on its own table (docs/P51-STAGE1.md); this aircraft's own recordings are unmoved.

z18_cross_host.source: the Zagi's recorded throw, climb, roll, glide and stall, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
